responsibility: Implements MSP430-specific GCC driver spec functions that rewrite or supplement command-line options before invoking the compiler and linker. It derives a matching -mcpu from -mmcu using MCU metadata, selects the hardware-multiply support library either from explicit -mhwmult settings or the chosen MCU, propagates region options to the linker under MSP430-specific rules, exposes a small hook for setting driver-side variables related to devices.csv handling, and computes the support-files linker search path. This file belongs to driver/spec processing rather than code generation, and its outputs are spec strings and diagnostics consumed by later driver phases.
